title: Positive-Negative Asymmetry of Contact - Experiment
descriptions: The main aim of the experiment was to test whether there is a stronger effect of negative than positive contact on intergroup attitudes (eg. The ‘positive-negative asymmetry of contact’); and whether these effects of positive and negative contact are moderated by the intensity of the contact experience.
